raw_sections.summary:
Msc.IT graduate with a proven track record in Back-end and Front-end Development, targeting opportunities in Software Development/Full-stack Development preferably in Chennai, Bangalore, Remote or Hybrid.
CAREER SUMMARY
Senior Full-Stack Engineer / Lead Developer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling high-performance web applications, data platforms, and Ai powered analytics systems. • Strong expertise across frontend, backend, data engineering and cloud-architecture. • Proven track record in end-to-end ownership of complex systems ranging from frontend UI/UX to backend
microservices & MVC API designs, ETL/ELT data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
Extensive experience working with marketing and e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Amazon Ads, Klaviyo, and building analytics dashboards, reporting pipelines, and deep-link integrations.
Managed a team of 5 UI developers, while working as a Sr. Software Developer/Full Stack Developer at IResponsive solution.
Collaborated in the recruitment process by conducting interviews of new candidates, exhibited leadership and interpersonal skills to assess their suitability for the role.
Expertise in implementing real-time monitoring and alerting mechanisms and ensuring continuous compliance and data integrity.
Excellence in ensuring a smooth transition during the data migration process, maintaining the stability of production and QA environments.
Hands-on experience in preserving data integrity and system functionality throughout the migration, and ensuring a reliable and efficient system post-migration.
Capable of offering suggestions for ongoing improvement & skilled in designing plans for stability, scalability, performance optimization & feature management.
Extensive knowledge and exposure in Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) right from requirement analysis, documentation (functional specifications, technical design), coding and testing (preparation of test cases along with implementation) to maintenance of proposed applications.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Full Stack Development • User Experience Design • Scripting and Algorithm • Data Engineering • Database Management • Responsive Design • Performance Optimization • Agile Methodology • Data Migration • Generative AI
TECHNICAL SKILLS
NodeJS | Python | ReactJS | AWS | GCP | Airflow | Kubernetes | Docker | Google ADK | ETL | Analytics
Programming Languages
JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Python, PHP
Frontend Technologies • React.js, Next.js • HTML5, CSS3, SCSS • State Management: Redux, Context API, React Query, Recoil • Responsive Design, UI/UX Optimization
Backend & API Development
Node.js (Express, NestJS) • Python (FastAPI) • RESTful APIs, GraphQL • OAuth & Authentication Flows • Serverless Architecture • Core-Php(Homestead, Laravel)
Databases & Data Stores
PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Amazon Redshift, BigQuery • Data Modelling, SQL Optimization
Data Engineering & Analytics
Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, ETL / ELT Pipelines
Cloud & Infrastructure
AWS: Lambda, EC2, ECS, ECR, S3, DynamoDB, Redshift, Event-Bridge, SQS, SNS, Step-Function, Kinesis-
Streams, Route 53, IAM, Secret Manager.
GCP: GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Composer • Docker, Kubernetes • Serverless Framework
DevOps & CI/CD
Docker, Kubernetes (GKE) • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Jenkins
Monitoring & Observability
Datadog, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch
Tools & Platforms
Git, GitHub, Jira, Swagger / OpenAPI, Zendesk, Redis Cache
Architectural & Engineering Practices
Microservices & Event-Driven Architecture • Domain-Driven Design (DDD) • Scalable System Design • Performance Optimization & Security Best Practices
raw_sections.education:
EDUCATION
Master of Science in Information Technology (M.Sc.IT) | GKM College of Engineering and Technology, 2017 Anna University
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior / Lead Full-Stack Engineer Company: Invictus Data | Trilio AI Project HSR Layout, Bengaluru | Aug 2025 – *Present | Hybrid • Led the design and development of a scalable analytics and data platform integrating e-commerce and
digital marketing sources.
Built frontend dashboards and admin portals using React.js, TypeScript, focusing on performance, modularity, and UX.
Developed backend microservices and APIs using Node.js and Python (FastAPI) with clean, domain-driven architecture.
Designed and owned ETL/ELT data pipelines supporting incremental and historical data ingestion. • Worked extensively with PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, and BigQuery for analytics-ready data modelling. • Integrated Shopify, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Amazon Ads, and Klaviyo using secure OAuth workflows. • Implemented unified deep-linking from analytics reports to third-party platform admin pages. • Deployed systems on AWS and GCP, using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability tools. • Acted as a technical lead, handling architecture decisions, code reviews, and mentoring.
Senior / Lead Full-Stack Engineer Company: Invictus Data | Client Samsung | Dynamic Audience Generator (DAG) Project SKCL Excellence, Chennai | Jan 2025 – July 2025 | Hybrid • Worked on the Dynamic Audience Generator (DAG) platform to build and manage data-driven marketing
audience segments at scale.
Led a major architecture revamp, migrating DAG workloads from legacy compute to cloud-native infrastructure on GCP.
Designed and implemented containerized services on GKE, improving scalability, fault tolerance, and deployment reliability.
Refactored backend services and data pipelines to enable horizontal scaling, better resource utilization, and lower latency.
Evaluated and recommended alternatives to the Pilosa query framework, analysing trade-offs in

performance, scalability, cost, and operational complexity. Improved audience query performance and flexibility by redesigning data access patterns and aggregation strategies.
Led a complete DAG UI/UX revamp, enhancing usability for audience creation, filtering, and validation. • Executed a React version upgrade, improving frontend performance, maintainability, and developer experience.
Refactored frontend code into modular, reusable components with cleaner state management. • Collaborated with data engineers, product teams, and Samsung stakeholders to align technical solutions with business and marketing goals.
Senior / Lead Full-Stack Engineer (Client SSENSE) Company: IResponsive Solutions | Client SSENSE | IMS, WMS, CS Application Development Coimbatore | May 2022 – Nov 2023 | Remote • Migrated data from legacy AWS environments to domain-specific AWS accounts, ensuring minimal
disruption, strong data integrity, and reliable deployments.
Designed and implemented an automated auditing system using Datadog and Swagger, enabling real-time monitoring, alerting, and compliance.
• Eliminated manual auditing workflows, significantly improving operational efficiency and data accuracy. • Developed and maintained Inventory Management (IMS), Warehouse Management (WMS), and Customer
Support (CS) applications.
Built scalable, high-performance systems using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, AWS, and Serverless Framework.
Performed continuous system optimization and performance tuning to ensure reliability and responsiveness.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams to deliver seamless feature integrations across multiple systems. • Reduced stock discrepancies by 85%, significantly improving inventory accuracy. • Contributed to a 55% revenue increase through enhanced inventory and warehouse management workflows. • Improved system usability, achieving a 98% reduction in user errors and 90% faster data access and processing.
Senior Software Developer (SDE II) Company: PaloAltoSoft Solutions | Clearspeed Project Gurugram | May 2021 – Apr 2022 | Remote • Engineered a SaaS-based Twilio Programmable Voice application using Node.js, AWS Lambda, and Twilio
APIs.
Built and optimized IVR-based interview and questionnaire workflows for the Clearspeed Interview Server Wrapper.
Developed scalable backend services to support automated voice-driven interviews with high reliability. • Integrated AWS CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, and S3 to enhance system observability, security, and scalability. Implemented a full-stack solution using Node.js, React.js, MongoDB, Twilio, and AWS Lambda.
• Ensured seamless integration with existing enterprise infrastructure while adhering to strict data privacy and compliance standards.
Optimized IVR performance to improve response accuracy, latency, and system stability. • Eliminated manual interview scheduling, achieving a 95% increase in interview completion rates. • Reduced maintenance costs by 70% through efficient architecture and reuse of existing infrastructure. • Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders to deliver a production-ready, high-impact solution.
Full-Stack Developer Company: Foodhub DLF Cyber City, Chennai | May 2017 – Mar 2021 | Hybrid • Revamped and maintained the CRM ecosystem, developing multiple applications to support customer
engagement and internal operations.
Designed and implemented recurring SMS and Email campaign systems, significantly improving customer communication and retention.
Built Twilio Programmable IVR applications to streamline customer interactions and support software teams and reduced customer response times by 90% through optimized IVR-based automation.
Engineered automation systems for Android app UI configurations, eliminating manual setup efforts. • Designed and implemented Native App Sales and Billing automation, ensuring accurate and seamless transactions.
Worked across a diverse tech stack including PHP, JavaScript, Node.js, React.js, MySQL, MongoDB, HTML5, CSS, Twilio, Plivo, AWS, Jenkins, and Git.
Collaborated closely with product, support, and engineering teams to deliver reliable, production-grade solutions.
